    Last Light

    A game about one summer in Oak Hollow, 2011,
    and the friends who rode until the streetlights came on.

    Created by

    GRothIsMonkey

    story and direction

    Built across many passes

    The game was developed over many implementation passes, chapter by chapter: structural, story and systems passes, and the Astra art and visual-polish passes, each one building on the last accepted release.

    Sound

    Every sound in the game is synthesized in your browser as you play: the cicadas, the bells, the voices calling down the street, the few notes of music.

    A full score and recorded voices are still to come.

    Technology

    Rendered with Three.js r160 (MIT license). Houses, trees, people and weather are generated by the game itself. Web Audio for sound.

    Typefaces: Cormorant Garamond and Karla (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

    Third-party art

    “Smily horror monster” by Bento (sketchfab.com/gostbento), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Modified and optimized for Last Light; the author does not endorse this use.

    For everyone who rode the long way home,
    and everyone who meant to keep in touch.
